findings.title: WP Maps Pro CVE-2026-8732 — Unauthenticated Admin-Account Creation Actively Exploited on ~15,000 WordPress Sites
findings.affected_technology: WP Maps Pro WordPress plugin (Envato Market) ≤ 6.1.0; fixed in 6.1.1 released 2026-05-20
findings.summary: Unauthenticated attackers call a vendor-support 'temporary access' AJAX endpoint protected only by a frontend-exposed nonce to create new WordPress administrator accounts with one-click passwordless login URLs; Wordfence blocked 3,600+ exploitation attempts in the 24h before disclosure (BleepingComputer 2026-05-31).

findings.title: Apache Airflow 16-CVE Batch — Authenticated RCE via XCom PATCH + BashOperator Jinja2 Injection + Multi-Endpoint AuthZ Bypass
findings.affected_technology: Apache Airflow data-orchestration platform (2.x + 3.x release branches per upstream advisory)
findings.summary: Sixteen-CVE coordinated disclosure on oss-security 2026-05-31 — highest-priority items CVE-2026-42359 authenticated RCE via XCom PATCH endpoint, CVE-2026-45360 arbitrary import in custom deadline-reference deserialization, and CVE-2026-42252 BashOperator Jinja2 template injection via dag_run.conf with low-privilege user pattern; remaining CVEs span DAG-permission filter bypass via Python lstrip() character-stripping on JWT cookies, JWT cookie missing Secure flag behind HTTPS-terminating proxies, cross-DAG bulk-TaskInstance mutation, template-truncation bypassing nested sensitive-key masking, and SMTP STARTTLS certificate-validation gaps.

findings.title: Apache ActiveMQ 6-CVE Batch — Jolokia addNetworkConnector RCE + Authorization Defects in Messaging Core
findings.affected_technology: Apache ActiveMQ Classic messaging broker (5.18.x / 5.19.x patched branches per Apache advisory)
findings.summary: Six-CVE batch disclosed on oss-security 2026-05-31 — highest-priority CVE-2026-42588 RCE via Jolokia addNetworkConnector (JMX-over-HTTP bridge enabled by default on the admin interface), plus companion discovery-side weakness CVE-2026-45505 in the same code path, CVE-2026-49157 authenticated low-privilege web users retain Jolokia capability after privilege downgrade, CVE-2026-42253 HTTP response header injection via JMS message properties, CVE-2026-46605 incomplete authorization during destination operations, and CVE-2026-49270 durable subscription disclosure via crafted message.

noted.summary: Authenticated RCE via Jython algorithm code injection (CVE-2026-46621), mission-database algorithm override (CVE-2026-46562), and Janino expression-engine injection (CVE-2026-44632) in Yamcs satellite mission-control / telemetry platform (GitHub Advisories 2026-05-31); aerospace / SCADA-ground-segment scope.
